body:
Google Ads & Commerce just pushed a fresh round of updates to how products show up in Shopping and across Google's surfaces.

Most small business owners never check the one setting this actually touches: the product feed. The feed is the file that tells Google what you sell, the price, the stock status. Not the ad. The ad just points at the feed.

Here's the part nobody checks. Open Merchant Center, go to Diagnostics, and look for disapproved or warning items. If your feed has errors, no amount of fixing the ad creative or the budget changes what Google shows. The feed is the product. The ad is just the poster for it.

This matters more now because Google keeps folding more of Shopping into AI-driven surfaces — the kind that pull straight from feed data, not from the ad copy you wrote. A clean feed used to be a nice-to-have. It is becoming the only lever that works.

Cost per lead, click-through rate, creative testing — all downstream of whether Google can even read your catalogue correctly.

Open Merchant Center today. Go to Diagnostics. How many items are sitting in "disapproved" right now, and do you know why?
